summary.text: Daughter of Meda wife of Idomeneus, slain with her mother in the temple by Leucus before the Cretan king returned from Troy — the child refuge that did not save either from the usurper's hand.

story.text: When Nauplius corrupted the heroes' wives on the Returns, Meda took Leucus as lover on Crete — the Cretan parallel to Clytemnestra and Aegisthus at Mycenae.

Before Idomeneus landed after Troy, Leucus killed Meda and her daughter Clisithyra, who had fled to a temple for refuge; he detached ten cities from Crete and made himself tyrant over them, driving the victor into exile when he came home.
